The RL circuit simulates the three-phase windings of a brushless DC motor, the current sampling module samples current on the RL circuit, and the touch screen is used to start the detection system and display the results. Finally, the system program was developed using the Keil development software. Experimental results show that the detection system has a compact structure, is easy to move, and can complete the functional detection of two drive boards within 30 seconds, significantly improving the detection efficiency of LAMOST fiber positioning robot drive boards.

articleTitle: A Configurable XMSS Post-Quantum Hardware Implementation with SM3 and SHA-256
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The eXtended Merkle Signature Scheme (XMSS) is a post-quantum secure signature scheme that is resistant to quantum attacks and has gained significant attention in recent years. This paper proposes an innovative XMSS configurable cryptographic hardware circuit based on hash functions SM3 and SHA-256. By reusing the computational circuits of the hash functions, the proposed design reduces hardware resource consumption and power dissipation. Implementation results on the Zynq-7000 FPGA show that the average signature generation time is 2.75 ms, the average verification time is 0.28 ms, and the computation time meets the requirements for secure boot.

articleTitle: IML-ViT-RSD: Enhancing Image Manipulation Localization with Multi-Scale Feature Extraction and Contextual Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of digital image processing, image tampering has become increasingly prevalent and sophisticated, particularly in complex backgrounds and highrisk scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an enhanced deep learning model, IML-ViT-RSD, based on the IMLViT architecture, designed to improve Image Manipulation Localization (IML) in such environments. First, we introduce an SIAF mechanism, which captures fine-grained relationships among high-level semantic features, enabling more precise IML traces. Next, a DSFPN is integrated to generate multi-scale semantic features, enhancing the model’s ability to handle diverse image contexts. To further improve generalization, depthwise separable convolutions are employed to reduce the parameter count. Finally, the RCM is introduced to refine contextual information modeling, strengthening the model’s understanding of multi-scale objects. Experimental results on the CASIA dataset demonstrate that the proposed model achieves an F1 score of 71.65, reflecting its robust generalization and resilience in IML.

articleTitle: A Multi-Mode Co-Directional Orthogonal Index OTFS Modulation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Amid the growing demand for communication in high-speed mobility and complex underwater acoustic channels, Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) modulation has emerged as a promising modulation technique due to its robust resistance to Doppler shift and its channel diversity gain properties, making it a research hotspot in underwater communication. However, in traditional OTFS with Index Modulation (OTFS-IM) systems, only a portion of the grid is activated, leading to silent subgrids and lower spectral efficiency. To improve spectral and energy efficiency, this paper proposes an innovative multi-mode co-directional orthogonal index OTFS modulation algorithm. This algorithm introduces co-directional orthogonal index modulation in the Delay-Doppler (DD) domain subgrids to enhance both spectral and energy efficiency. Simulation results show that the multi-mode co-directional orthogonal index OTFS modulation algorithm exhibits superior bit error rate (BER) performance and spectral efficiency compared to the traditional OTFS-IM system under different modulation orders. These improvements position the proposed approach as an efficient solution for underwater communication in high-speed mobile environments, with promising potential for broader practical applications.

Author Keywords: Multi-Mode In-Phase and Quadrature Orthogonal Index

articleTitle: A Method for Cross-Network Service Forwarding Based on Unidirectional Network Isolation Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the increasing severity of network security threats, physical isolation has become an important means of protecting high-security networks. However, traditional network isolation devices only support unidirectional file transfer, which cannot meet modern organizations’ urgent needs for real-time service calls across networks. This paper proposes a service forwarding method based on the unidirectional transmission characteristics of network isolation devices, achieving crossnetwork service calls in isolated network environments through innovative architectural design. The method adopts a collaborative working mode between External Proxy Service (EPS) and Internal Proxy Service (IPS), combining asymmetric encryption technology with the physical isolation characteristics of network isolation devices to build a secure and reliable crossnetwork service call mechanism. Through carefully designed protocol conversion and data encapsulation schemes, the method achieves API-level cross-network service access while maintaining network physical isolation. Experimental results show that the method has excellent reliability and security. This research provides an innovative solution to the challenge of service calls in physically isolated network environments, balancing security and business efficiency. The method’s design concepts and implementation approaches have important reference value for cross-network service calls in similar scenarios, providing a new technical path for building more secure and efficient cross-domain service systems.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Efficiency Optimization of IoT Nodes Based on Event-Triggered Pulse Control
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The advent of the Internet of Things (IoT) has brought with it a rapid proliferation of applications, which has in turn created a significant challenge for IoT nodes operating in resource-constrained environments in terms of energy efficiency. In this paper, we put forward a model for optimising the energy efficiency of IoT nodes based on event-triggered pulse control. Based on the existing pulse-width modulation (PWM) and eventtriggered control models, we propose a novel hybrid method that combines event-triggered control and adaptive pulse modulation to dynamically adjust the energy consumption of node activities. The model employs a multi-level control architecture that integrates real-time monitoring, threshold-based event detection, and machine learning algorithms for adaptive control parameter tuning, thereby optimising energy utilisation and computational load. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model exhibits a {3 0%} improvement in energy efficiency compared to existing energy efficiency optimisation models, while maintaining the same level of performance and reliability.

articleTitle: Enhance Implicit Sentiment Analysis through Multi-Step Prompting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Implicit sentiment analysis, as a challenging branch of sentiment analysis tasks, faces issues such as the lack of explicit sentiment features and the complexity of textual semantics. This study is inspired by the Chain of Thought (CoT) method and proposes a framework called Multi-Step Prompting of Chain of Thought (MSP-CoT). First, the framework employs a multi-step prompting reasoning process that combines the common-sense reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with CoT method to effectively analyze aspects and implicit opinions within the text. Then, it connects the aspects and implicit opinions derived from the preceding prompts with the context, serving as the input for the final prompt, thereby gradually inducing sentiment polarity. We evaluated the model using the SemEval 2014 dataset, and the experimental results indicate that the proposed method substantially outperforms existing baselines. Compared to baseline models, our MSP-CoT model demonstrates a significant improvement. Notably, ChatGPT + MSP-CoT achieves an improvement of $\mathbf{4 2. 6 1 \%}$ in F1 score in the overall setting compared to traditional models.

articleTitle: Sparse and Low-rank Decomposition of Hankel Matrix for SAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Sparse Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imaging based on compressive sensing allows radar systems to capture targets with sampling rates below the Nyquist limit by exploiting target sparsity. However, preserving the structural integrity of original data, particularly for periodic or correlated targets, remains a challenge. To address this, we propose a novel SAR imaging approach that incorporates prior target information using sparse and low-rank decomposition of Hankel matrices. Our method employs nuclear norm minimization with low-rank matrix factorization initialization to decompose these matrices, eliminating the need for explicit dictionary priors. By leveraging the duality between signal sparsity and low-rank structures, the method adapts to targets with complex or varying characteristics. Using alternating direction method of multipliers for reconstruction, the approach demonstrates superior performance in real SAR data.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction Algorithm of Data Acquisition Card Based on Sparrow Search Algorithm Optimized Variational Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the increasing demand of high-precision data acquisition card in application, noise suppression in the process of signal acquisition becomes very important. The existence of noise will not only reduce the signal quality and affect the measurement accuracy, but also lead to data distortion and system performance degradation. In order to meet this challenge, a variational mode decomposition (VMD) parameter adaptive denoising method based on sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is proposed in this paper. In this method, the parameters of VMD algorithm are adjusted by SSA optimization technology to adapt to different noise characteristics, so as to improve the effect of signal noise reduction. The experimental results show that the method can significantly improve the signal-to-noise ratio by 8.4 %. These results verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm, and provide an innovative solution for signal noise suppression of data acquisition card.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Health Monitoring of Distributed Computing Architecture: Insights from XGBoost and SHAP
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, its application in the optimization of complex computer systems is becoming more and more extensive. Edge computing is an efficient distributed computing architecture, and the health status of its nodes directly affects the performance and reliability of the entire system. In view of the lack of accuracy and interpretability of traditional methods in node health status judgment, this paper proposes a health status judgment method based on XGBoost and combines the SHAP method to analyze the interpretability of the model. Through experiments, it is verified that XGBoost has superior performance in processing complex features and nonlinear data of edge computing nodes, especially in capturing the impact of key features (such as response time and power consumption) on node status. SHAP value analysis further reveals the global and local importance of features, so that the model not only has high-precision discrimination ability but also can provide intuitive explanations, providing data support for system optimization. Research shows that the combination of AI technology and computer system optimization can not only realize the intelligent monitoring of the health status of edge computing nodes but also provide a scientific basis for dynamic optimization scheduling, resource management and anomaly detection. In the future, with the in-depth development of AI technology, model dynamics, cross-node collaborative optimization and multimodal data fusion will become the focus of research, providing important support for the intelligent evolution of edge computing systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic Attention-Gated Transformer Network Model for Multi-Time-Step Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Time series forecasting is a critical task in many fields, with wide applications in industries such as energy, retail, and finance. Traditional time series forecasting methods often fail to effectively capture complex nonlinear patterns and interdependencies among variables. In recent years, deep learning techniques have made significant progress in time series forecasting. This paper proposes the DAGNet model to address the need for multi-time-step time series forecasting. DAGNet effectively handles various input types, including static covariates, prior known inputs, and observed inputs, through a dynamic attention mechanism and gating mechanism. Meanwhile, DAGNet also enhances the interpretability of forecasts, enabling users to identify globally important variables and duration patterns. Experimental results show that DAGNet outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) models in forecasting performance.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a CIME Model for Data Asset Evaluation Based on Mobile Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In this digital age, data assets have become one of the most valuable resources for enterprises and organizations. In order to accurately estimate and manage the value of data assets, a CIME (cost, intrinsic value, market supply and demand, environmental constraints) model based on mobile cloud is proposed. This paper reviews the research status and challenges of data asset evaluation, and introduces the architecture design of CIME model, the evaluation method of data assets, the implementation of mobile and cloud services, and the security and privacy measures. The test results on the proposed CIME model show that the maintenance efficiency percentage is over 80.9%, and the evaluation time is between 418 ms and 681 ms, which is lower than the traditional evaluation method (711 ms), and the cost-benefit ratio is obviously higher than the traditional method, and the highest is $\mathbf{2. 1 7}$.

articleTitle: Liquid Level Fiber Sensor Based on Fully Connected Neural Network and In-line Mach-Zehnder Interferometer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: An innovative fiber optic liquid level sensor based on a peanut-shaped fiber structure has been designed and fabricated for use in micro-buoy systems. This sensor features two cascaded peanut-shaped structures with a 25 mm spacing, and its sensing characteristics have been thoroughly studied. This setup achieves millimeter-level monitoring intervals by measuring changes in interference wavelengths, enabling the system to accurately deduce the current liquid level state with a sensitivity of 0.087 $\mathrm{nm} / \mathrm{mm}$. To enhance the accuracy of data analysis, a Fully Connected Neural Network (FCNN) has been implemented for data processing and analysis. After training this model, the average percentage error was successfully reduced to 0.76%. Consequently, this cutting-edge fiber optic liquid level sensor demonstrates significant potential for precise measurements in marine micro-buoy systems, thereby ensuring seamless monitoring and robust protection of offshore wind energy installations and critical port infrastructures. The design effectively demonstrates the potential development space for the application of artificial intelligence and fiber optic sensing technology in oceanic micro-buoy liquid level measurement.

articleTitle: Deep Dynamic Ensemble Classification for Brain Tumor MRI
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Traditional models for brain tumor diagnosis often struggle with limited prediction accuracy, largely due to their inability to fully capture the heterogeneous nature and complexity of tumor characteristics. Moreover, they lack the adaptability required for generalization across diverse datasets. In response to these limitations, this paper proposes a novel brain tumor classification framework using dynamic ensemble learning to improve diagnostic accuracy. The proposed framework combines a pool of pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with an adaptive selection mechanism to dynamically choose the most effective classifier based on task-specific metrics. This dynamic adjustment of CNN weights integrates each model’s strengths, boosting predictive accuracy and robustness. Extensive experiments across various datasets confirm our approach outperforms single models and the existing methods on multiple performance indicators

articleTitle: Optimizing Training Performance via Omni-Block Sparsity Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In recent years, neural networks have become more complicated, there has been an increased requirement for efficient communication in distributed deep learning. Optimizing both accuracy and model training speed in traditional approaches often be hard. In this paper, we propose a novel approach called Omni-Block Sparsity Adaptation (OBSA), which partitions the model’s gradients into multiple blocks and dynamically adjusts the sparsity of each block based on its properties. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves Top-1 accuracy across multiple architectures, achieving impressive speedups of up to $11.29 x$ compared to existing AllReduce methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of YOLOv5 Model in Household Waste Classification and Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the increasing awareness of environmental protection, intelligent household waste classification has become an important part of urban management. However, the traditional household waste classification is inefficient and prone to make mistakes. Therefore, this paper proposes a smart waste classification and detection method based on YOLOv5 to improve the accuracy and efficiency of domestic waste classification. First of all, facing the problem of unbalanced and inaccurate junk image data, the comprehensiveness of model training is ensured through data annotation and enhancement technology. Subsequently, after an in-depth comparison of multiple models, YOLOv5 was selected as the best model. Then, the model profile is adjusted for hyperparameter processing to improve the performance and generalization ability of the model ${ }^{[11}$. Fully trained and rigorously evaluated, the model performs well in the detection and classification tasks. Finally, the optimized model is applied to the actual scene to realize the detection and classification of intelligent household waste.

articleTitle: A Fast and Resource-Friendly Hardware Accelerator for Non-Maximal Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The non-maximal suppression (NMS) operator is widely utilized in the post-processing phase of target recognition neural networks. However, its high computation overhead and complex operational process, pose significant challenges to the efficiency of target recognition systems. Some works have been proposed to speed up NMS with FPGA but still cost too much latency and hardware resources. In view of this, we introduce a fast and resource friendly hardware NMS accelerator. Specifically, we first determine the most confidential category of each bounding box with a preprocessing unit, and then determine whether a box should be kept or not quickly by comparing its confidence and calculating the Intersection-Over-Union (IOU) with those of the previously stored boxes in parallel. Experimental results on the Xilinx VCK190 hardware platform reveal that, in comparison to the cutting-edge O3NMS accelerators, the proposed accelerator offers a substantial speedup of approximately 20% while utilizing 21.4% more LUTs and 81.5% less Flip Flops.

articleTitle: Research on Adjustable Wavelength Transmitter-receiver Isolation Technology for Inter-satellite Laser Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of inter-satellite laser communication network technology and the widespread application of integrated optical antennas, it is crucial to achieve light beam transmitter-receiver isolation for optical antennas. At the same time, to achieve frequency point switching between homogeneous or heterogeneous constellations, the system urgently needs to have the ability to adjust the wavelength for transmitter-receiver isolation. In response to these needs, this paper focuses on the research on adjustable wavelength transmitter-receiver isolation based on Fabry-Perot (F-P) type thin film filter (TFF), analyzes the principle of thin film filter theoretically, and conducts experimental verification. When the target wavelength is 20 nm away from the local light wavelength, the system isolation can reach up to 81.3 dB, which is basically consistent with the theoretical analysis. The results show that the above method can achieve adjustable wavelength transmitterreceiver isolation for inter-satellite laser communication.

articleTitle: Single Snapshot Direction-Of-Arrival Estimation via Signal Fitting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: A novel single snapshot direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation method is proposed in this paper. Note that the observation at hand is contaminated by noise, we propose a signal fitting framework by using least squares (LS) together with the decomposition property of the interested signal to first retrieve the noise-free interested signal. This signal fitting framework can be equivalently transformed into a least squares programming with low-ranked positive semidefinite Toeplitz-Hankel constraint, which can be efficiently implemented via the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). Moreover, the unknown DOAs can be obtained from the constructed Toeplitz matrix by employing classical Vandermonde decomposition techniques. Compared with the existing compressed sensing based DOA estimation algorithms, the proposed method does not need the noise statistics. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness and outperformance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on the verification method of the Event-B model for the heterogeneous multi-core scheduling algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: It is well known that the logical verification for the operating system is very essential. Event-B, as a formal verification tool, is one of the most widely used methods for verifying programs at the operating system level. However, it lacks the precise time semantics expression that will make the representation of the behavioral logic complicated for verified scheduling process. To address this limitation, we proposes an EMPT (Event-B Multi-core Processor Time) model in rodin platform, which can represent the time semantics by using set mappings and operations. After that we apply it to the logical verification for the heterogeneous multicore scheduling algorithm (HEFT), and the results show that it can verify the accuracy of this algorithm.

articleTitle: A Method for Converting Oracle Stored Procedures to Java Code
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Based on the strong demand for independent control and the improvement of domestic databases, database localization has become an inevitable trend. In the process of migrating Oracle databases to domestic databases, due to the great differences in procedural SQL languages between different databases, the migration of stored procedures becomes a difficult point in the process of database object migration. Moreover, some distributed domestic databases do not support stored procedures, and it is impossible to migrate Oracle stored procedures to distributed domestic databases. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes a method to convert Oracle stored procedures into Java code, directly converting Oracle storage into executable code, avoiding the migration of stored procedures between heterogeneous databases, and reducing the difficulty of migrating Oracle databases to domestic databases.

articleTitle: 5G in Military Applications: Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The advent of 5G technology introduces significant advancements in communication, marked by high speed, low latency, and massive connectivity. These attributes position 5G as a promising technology for military applications, yet its design for civilian use presents challenges when adapted to the harsh conditions of the battlefield. The challenges 5G faces in military applications are examined in this paper, including differences in design objectives, antenna technologies, anti-jamming capabilities, core network dependencies, and resilience. It also explores the transformative opportunities 5G offers, such as real-time battlefield awareness, autonomous system coordination, and enhanced communication capacity. By bridging the gap between civilian and military requirements, 5G technology could revolutionize military communication systems.

articleTitle: Artificial bee colony algorithm with multiple search strategies and neighborhood search
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm does well in exploration but badly in exploitation in the process of solution search. During the evolution, How to balance the exploration and the exploitation of ABC algorithms has been a new challenge. To solve this problem, one new ABC algorithms was proposed which called NMuABC in this paper. In NMuABC algorithms, three different search methods are used in the employed bee phase, and everyone in the population dynamically selects the appropriate strategy for updating the solution during the evolutionary process. In onlooker bee phase, it uses the neighborhood selection mechanism to search near the elite solution to improve the development of the algorithm. In order to evaluate the performance of the NMuABC algorithm, 22 classic functions were used for testing. NMuABC was compared with other ABCs Algorithm. The results show that NMuABC algorithm performs better than compared algorithm, and it has fast global convergence speed and can get better solution.

articleTitle: Closed optimal dimension reduction for skew-filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Skewed Kalman filtering is a powerful tool for statistical inference of measurements with asymmetric noise. However, it suffers from the problem of increasing dimensionality during recursive estimation, which can present a numerical computational barrier. Although a number of techniques exist to provide solutions, these methods are usually too complex for multidimensional problems. In this paper, a new optimisation scheme is proposed to reduce the dimensionality of the skewness of the closed skew normal distribution, and the solution of this optimisation scheme is analytical, which greatly improves the computational efficiency. The effectiveness of the proposed method is then shown through numerical examples. The results show that the method facilitates recursive state estimation in the presence of skewed noise.

articleTitle: A Method for Designing Camouflage Waveform Based on PCFM Waveform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The paper introduces the concept of camouflage waveform in response to the limitations of traditional anti-reconnaissance waveform design methods, and designs such a waveform specifically for the widely-used Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM) radar waveform. To tackle the challenge of elevated sidelobes in camouflage waveforms, a momentum gradient descent algorithm based on Goldstein criterion is proposed to effectively minimize these sidelobes.

articleTitle: Optimizing Large Language Models with an Enhanced LoRA Fine-Tuning Algorithm for Efficiency and Robustness in NLP Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This study proposes a large language model optimization method based on the improved LoRA fine-tuning algorithm, aiming to improve the accuracy and computational efficiency of the model in natural language processing tasks. We fine-tune the large language model through a low-rank adaptation strategy, which significantly reduces the consumption of computing resources while maintaining the powerful capabilities of the pre-trained model. The experiment uses the QQP task as the evaluation scenario. The results show that the improved LoRA algorithm shows significant improvements in accuracy, F1 score, and MCC compared with traditional models such as BERT, Roberta, T5, and GPT-4. In particular, in terms of F1 score and MCC, our model shows stronger robustness and discrimination ability, which proves the potential of the improved LoRA algorithm in fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained models. In addition, this paper also discusses the application prospects of the improved LoRA algorithm in other natural language processing tasks, emphasizing its advantages in multi-task learning and scenarios with limited computing resources. Future research can further optimize the LoRA fine-tuning strategy and expand its application in larger-scale pre-trained models to improve the generalization ability and task adaptability of the model.

articleTitle: Research on UAV-assisted maritime communication method based on K-means algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: As wireless communication technology continues to evolve and 6G mobile communication networks strive to create a fully connected communication world, the use of drones in wireless communication networks is becoming more prevalent. Compared with traditional terrestrial communication infrastructure The use of UAVs to assist offshore communication has great advantages, such as UAVs can provide line-of-sight links to improve the quality and capacity of the signal, the high mobility and flexibility of UAVs make them adaptable to complex wireless communication environments at sea, and UAV communication is more cost-effective with a wider coverage range. By obtaining the position information of a UAV node in a UAV cluster communication group network as a data set. Calculate the distance between the position information of the initial cluster head UAV and the position information of the UAV nodes based on the dataset to obtain the internal cluster distance set, and determine the new cluster of the UAV cluster based on the internal cluster distance set. The k -means algorithm is used to average the position information of the UAV nodes in the new cluster of UAV clusters, and iterative clustering by clusters is carried out to obtain the center position information, and the UAV cluster communication group network is reconstructed according to the center position information. This method can realize flexible self-organized network clustering and cluster head selection and reconstruction of UAV clusters under high dynamic environment, and improve the quality of large-scale UAV cluster communication and the number of communication service people under emergency rescue environment.

articleTitle: Wideband DOA Estimation Based on ConvNeXt
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a ConvNeXt method for direction of arrival (DOA) estimation aimed at enhancing the accuracy of wideband signals. The method utilizes the spatial covariance matrix components of each frequency subband as inputs to the network, thereby leveraging the data characteristics across different frequency subbands of the wideband signal to facilitate the regression of angular values, it uses DOA estimation as a regression task to directly obtain DOA values. Additionally, the CosineAnnealing algorithm is employed during the training process to adaptively adjust the network’s learning rate to improve the effect. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method. The ConvNeXt network exhibits superior estimation error performance compared to traditional methods, particularly at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and limited snapshots. Furthermore, this method maintains low algorithmic complexity while ensuring high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Active RIS with Artificial Noise Assisted Downlink Physical Layer Secure Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Active RIS is a technology that combines an active antenna array and a reflective smart surface. It is a novel smart surface technology, the core of which is a two-dimensional array consisting of a large number of programmable antenna units. These antenna units can not only reflect the incident beam, but also amplify or modulate the signal, thus possessing the ability to actively transmit and receive signals. On this basis, we investigate active RIS-assisted downlink physical layer secure transmission while the user maximizes the security rate by sending artificial noise to the eavesdropper while receiving the message. Jointly, we optimize the base station beamforming, the active RIS beamforming, and the power allocation between the active RIS and the artificial noise.The paper proposes an alternating optimization algorithm to solve the problem. Since the optimization problem is non-convex, we use the successive convex approximation algorithm (SCA) and the semi-positive definite relaxation algorithm (SDR) to solve the problem. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by experimental simulation results.

articleTitle: Cascade Coding Scheme Based on the Reliability Problem of Resistive Random-Access Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Resistive random-access memory (ReRAM) is an ideal candidate for next-generation memory devices. However, its inherent sneak path issue limits its practical applications. This problem can be mitigated by integrating selectors in series with ReRAM cells. Nevertheless, unexpected failures of selectors during operation not only reintroduce the sneak path issue but also lead to new data loss problems. This paper addresses the data errors caused by selector failures in series-connected configurations. A cascade coding scheme is proposed for ReRAM arrays, utilizing Polar codes as the inner code to correct random errors across the array and Reed-Solomon (RS) codes as the outer code to address errors caused by sneak paths and selector-induced data loss. The cascade coding approach effectively reduces the bit error rate (BER) while maintaining a manageable decoding complexity.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of HF Communication System Based on Text Modal Semantic Encoding
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for the reliability of HF communication, there is an urgent need to explore new methods to enhance its performance. We design an HF communication system based on text modal semantic encoding by introducing the relevant methods of semantic communication. A comparison is made between the proposed system and traditional HF communication system using BLEU score and semantic similarity score. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves BLEU scores and semantic similarity scores comparable to the traditional system at a lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), significantly enhancing the reliability of HF communication.

articleTitle: Receiver Design for LEO Satellite Based Asynchronous Massive Access
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Low earth orbit (LEO) satellite communication systems offer significant advantages, including extensive coverage, low latency, and reduced deployment costs, making them particularly suitable for massive access scenarios. However, they also face a number of challenges, such as high user mobility, frequent handovers, and large variations in delay. In this paper, we address the problem of massive asynchronous access in LEO satellite communications by proposing a novel receiver design based on the generalized approximate message passing (GAMP) and bilinear generalized approximate message passing (BiG-AMP) algorithm. Our scheme emphasizes multi-path largescale asynchronous access with unknown delays at the receiver, enabling the simultaneous estimation of user activity and channel state information. The receiver architecture is divided into two modules: equivalent channel estimation (ECE) and delay and channel decomposition (DCD). Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed receiver significantly enhances detection performance and channel estimation accuracy under the constraints of massive connectivity and asynchronous transmissions.

articleTitle: Advanced Fault Diagnosis of DC-DC Power Modules Using Wavelet Packet Decomposition and Few-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In order to address the problem of limited samples in the fault diagnosis of DC-DC (Direct Current to Direct Current, DC-DC) power modules, this paper proposes a method combining wavelet analysis and Few-Shot Learning. Wavelet packet decomposition is used to extract multifrequency features from output voltage signals, using Euclidean distance (L2 metric) to measure similarity between samples. The experimental results show that the proposed method can efficiently identify and classify faults under various degraded states of the power devices. Compared to the baseline model, the proposed method has been shown to improve fault detection accuracy by 18.12% using only six samples per class and by 6.37% using 100 samples per class. This approach is well-suited for real-world applications where data is limited, as it not only addresses the challenge of scarce data but also enhances the robustness and reliability of the fault diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Multi-link Fusion Transmission System for Laser Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In inter-satellite laser communication networks, communication links typically exhibit minimal delay and bandwidth variation, offering relatively uniform characteristics. For scenarios involving massive data transmission, multi-link fusion transmission can significantly enhance overall network efficiency and substantially expand system bandwidth by utilizing idle links. This paper proposes a novel multi-link fusion transmission system for laser communication networking. This system can improve the utilization rate of the entire network link. The experimental results show that the comprehensive bandwidth utilization rate of multiple links reaches ${9 7 \%}$.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Climatic Test Sequence on the Image Quality of Optical Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Optical imaging systems are widely used in various video surveillance sites, which may withstand various harsh environmental aging conditions such as salt spray, high and low temperatures. At present, more attention has been paid to the impact of a single environmental factor on the overall imaging quality of the system, but there is a lack of research on the impact of a series of climate tests on the overall imaging quality of the system. In this paper, the quantitative effects of two typical climatic test sequences on the imaging quality of a typical imaging system are studied. Imaging resolution, color reproduction and gray scale were selected as the main imaging quality parameters. It is found that different climatic experiment sequences have different effects on the imaging quality of the imaging system. It was found that the harshness of test sequence 1 was much higher than that of sequence 2, which caused more damage to the sample. Therefore, in the process of evaluating the reliability of the sample, the appropriate test sequence should be selected. The research of this paper will provide some reference for the revision of standards and the reasonable formulation of test schemes for test engineers.

articleTitle: Residual LSTM Radar Target Detection Method Based on Global Channel Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In radar target detection, large targets often mask small targets, and the traditional constant false alarm (CFAR) detection method is difficult to set a suitable threshold and cannot cope with the detection of this type of target well. Aiming at this kind of problem, a residual LSTM detection method based on global channel attention mechanism (Global Channel Attention Mechanism- Long Short Term Memory, GCAMLSTM) is proposed. This method processes the radar echo data, establishes the time-order relationship of the radar signals through the sliding window method, and proposes a new Global Channel Attention Mechanism module according to the characteristics of the time-order signals, so as to extract the target echo features more accurately. The experimental results show that the detection performance of the proposed method is $\mathbf{6. 8 \%}$ higher than that of the traditional CFAR algorithm. It has strong robustness in the above scenario and can achieve effective detection of radar targets.

articleTitle: Key Distribution Using Scrambling of Digital Signals in Multimode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: We propose and verify a scheme that leverages the reciprocity and multipath scattering effects of multimode fibers to use them as scrambling devices. Each of the legitimate users possesses a segment of multimode fiber to scramble digital signals. When the scrambled digital signals are transmitted to a remote end through the transmission link, they need to pass through the multimode fiber at the remote end for a second scrambling to ensure security. Since the scrambling effect on the signal only exists in the multimode fiber, channel interference is compensated for, significantly enhancing transmission distance while maintaining high correlation. Additionally, the device’s security stems from its intrinsic state, as devices in different locations and environments exhibit varying states. The results show that even if an eavesdropper obtains a device with similar parameters, they cannot achieve the same sequence as the legitimate end-users. Ultimately, we achieved a key distribution rate of $0.18 \mathrm{Gbit} / \mathrm{s}$ using two segments of multimode fiber to scramble signals over a 50 km single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: A Visual Communication Optimization Method for Human-Computer Interaction Interfaces Using Fuzzy Logic and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a visual communication optimization method for human-computer interaction interfaces based on fuzzy logic and wavelet transform, aiming to solve the problems of blurred information, unclear edge details, and noise interference in interface visual communication. First, fuzzy logic is used to quantify fuzzy areas and uncertain information in the image, and fuzzy clustering methods are used to achieve precise positioning and feature enhancement of key areas; then, wavelet transform is used to decompose the image into multiple scales to effectively separate low-frequency areas. The overall structural information and edge detail features of high-frequency areas highlight key visual elements in the interface. The optimized human-computer interaction interface has clearer edge contours, effectively suppressed noise, and more accurate expression of visual information. In the experimental part, edge detection, noise suppression evaluation, multi-scale visual detail retention, and user satisfaction comparison experiments were conducted. The results show that after fuzzy logic and wavelet transform processing, the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of the interface image is significantly improved, the edge clarity is significantly improved at different scales, and the user satisfaction level is “satisfied” and “very satisfied” The rating ratio has increased significantly. This method shows superiority in terms of visual communication quality, information accuracy, and user experience, and has strong practicability and stability. In the future, this method can be further combined with deep learning, personalized recommendations and virtual reality technology to promote the intelligent and efficient development of humancomputer interaction interfaces in more fields.

articleTitle: A Doppler frequency offset estimation and compensation method in low earth orbit satellite systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: To address the challenges of Doppler frequency offset (DFO) estimation in low earth orbit (LEO) satellite communication scenarios, a method for DFO estimation and compensation is proposed in LEO satellite systems. The method initially employs ephemeris data and terminal information for a coarse estimation of the DFO, followed by a pre-compensation of the coarse estimation results. After pre-compensation, a pilot segment method is utilized for residual frequency offset estimation. Finally, the coarse frequency offset estimation derived from ephemeris data is treated as prior information, which is integrated with the pilot segment-based frequency offset estimation method to achieve precise frequency offset estimation using the maximum a posteriori probability approach. Simulation results show the superiority of the proposed scheme in LEO satellite systems.

articleTitle: Influence of Ionospheric Scintillation on Satcom Station Communication and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of ionospheric scintillation effect is summarized. In order to predict ionospheric scintillation intensity, an ionospheric scintillation model (GISM) is established, and the possibility of predicting ionospheric scintillation index, amplitude fading index and other parameters is realized. The working principle of ionospheric scintillation monitoring equipment based on GNSS satellite is introduced. According to the real ionospheric scintillation events, the influence of ionospheric scintillation events on satellite communication is discussed. Finally, the countermeasures are proposed.

articleTitle: RegexExplainer: Automatic Description Generation for Regular Expressions via Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Regular expressions can describe specific matching rules, which can be used to determine the string format or extract the string content. Until now, regular expressions have been widely used in various operating systems and have been supported by most programming languages. However, the understanding of regular expressions is challenging for end-users or developers, who may not familiar with the syntax of regular expressions. Therefore, it is pressing for researchers to put forward effective methods to automatically generate functional descriptions for regular expressions. In this study, we formalize the description generation of the regular expression as a neural machine translation task. Then we propose a fully data-driven method RegexExplainer based on Transformer. Specifically, it uses Regex Encoder and AST Encoder to jointly learn the encoding information of regular expressions. In order to confirm the effectiveness of RegexExplainer, we build a high-quality corpus that consists of 107,851 pairs of regular expressions along with their corresponding descriptions. The final experimental results demonstrate that RegexExplainer is able to attain better performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines when it comes to three performance measures.

articleTitle: Research on Networking Technologies of Inter-Satellite Laser Communication with Multi-Aperture Arrays
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In response to the requirements of the space information network for laser networking, this research proposes a networking technology for inter-satellite laser communication with multi-aperture arrays. Firstly, the margin of the communication link is calculated by combining the indicators of the inter-satellite laser communication networking system with multi-aperture arrays and the engineering implementation capabilities. Then, in view of the impact of the coupling efficiency of the transmission system on the communication link, a fiber coupling assembly and adjustment method based on spiral scanning is proposed. Secondly, the analysis of the reflection system is completed. Through the design of tooling, the splicing and grinding of the reflectors are achieved. It is measured that the surface figure of the transmission system is better than $\lambda / 20$, and the surface figure of the reflection system is better than $\lambda / 10$. Finally, the experimental verification of the space laser communication link in the laboratory is carried out. The experimental results show that the communication rate of the inter-satellite laser communication networking system with multi-aperture arrays is $\geqslant 10 \mathrm{Gbps}$. Under different code patterns, the bit error rate is better than $1 \mathrm{E}-6$, meeting the requirements of the system’s technical indicators and verifying the effectiveness of the methods and core technologies described in this research.

articleTitle: Research on the Correctness Determination Method of Question-Answering Based on Multiple LLMs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized interactive experiences in artificial intelligence, with broad applications across various sectors including education, healthcare, and public welfare. However, challenges such as data bias, overgeneralization, and an absence of emotional cognition often lead to inaccurate or irrelevant responses in practical AI question-answering scenarios. This study addresses these issues by proposing a correctness determination method for question-answering based on multiple LLMs. We aim to enhance the accuracy of AI assistants in complex or ambiguous question handling by leveraging multiple pre-trained models and employing a decision model to select the most appropriate responses. Our approach integrates crossquestioning, historical feedback, and a novel election algorithm based on historical results weighting. The study demonstrates that this method significantly improves the accuracy of questionanswering results in smart university campus assistants, increasing the overall accuracy rate from $\mathbf{6 0. 3 3 \%}$ to $\mathbf{8 0. 1 6 \%}$. The proposed solution is not only cost-effective but also reduces reliance on labor, making it accessible for individuals and small businesses. This abstract summarizes our research background, purpose, methods, and the significant improvement in AI question-answering accuracy achieved through our multi-LLM approach.

articleTitle: HAZOP entity-relation ternary recognition model based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Industries such as chemical and manufacturing often have significant safety risks associated with their production processes, and it is critical to conduct a HAZOP safety analysis of the entire process before an accident occurs. However, the large amount of expert knowledge contained in HAZOP reports is not fully utilized. To solve the current problems, this paper proposes a fused deep learning model to extract unstructured expert knowledge of HAZOP by entity recognition and relation extraction of HAZOP safety analysis text. Compared with ordinary text, HAZOP text has a denser professional vocabulary, which leads to great difficulty in entity recognition. Based on the language feature of the HAZOP report, this paper combines the ACmix model, which is good at processing local features in the visual field, with the SPN model to effectively improve the recognition ability of the HAZOP entity-relation triplet. By changing the size of the convolution kernel and reducing the dimension of the attention mechanism, the ACmix model is applied to the text domain for the first time. The research results in this paper can be used in the future for the automatic construction of knowledge graphs in the fields of chemical industry and manufacturing, which can help enterprises analyze safety accidents as well as optimize and improve equipment.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Imbalanced Data Classification Using TwinSVM-One versus All and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Imbalanced multi-class datasets present significant challenges in classification tasks within machine learning. This study introduces a novel approach by integrating Twin SVM-OvA with the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique to improve classification performance on imbalanced datasets. The effectiveness of the proposed method was tested on six benchmark datasets, with performance evaluated using metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and the F1-measure. The experimental results demonstrate that Twin SVM-OvA-SMOTE outperforms other baseline methods, achieving the highest average accuracy of 88%, with improvements ranging from 7.4% to 10.1%. The proposed method achieved perfect classification on specific datasets, such as Dermatology, and significantly enhanced performance on highly imbalanced datasets like Arrhythmia. These results highlight the effectiveness of the proposed method in addressing class imbalance and improving classification performance.

articleTitle: A real-time TX-RX leakage cancellation in RF transceiver
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The growing demand for integration level of RF transceiver leads to the deterioration of isolation between transmission (TX) and receiving (RX) channel. The out-of-band nonlinear component of TX is likely to hit RX band in FDD scene and deteriorate receiver’s sensitivity. The traditional studies of leakage cancellation method focus on the leak point of RF poweramplifier. However, as the widespread using of Digital PreDistortion (DPD) algorithm in transceiver, the out-of-band predistortion component in TX channel will interfere $R X$ channel if the isolation level between TX pin and RX pin is insufficient. This paper presents a real-time digital cancellation algorithm for TXRX leakage. Compared to other solutions in the industry, the proposed algorithm introduces frequency-domain process and linkage design with AGC, which can maintain good performance in large blocking scenario, and is well-balanced between algorithm complexity and performance.

articleTitle: Adaptive Attention and Feature Embedding for Enhanced Entity Extraction Using an Improved Bert Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This paper proposes an entity extraction algorithm based on improved Bert. By introducing a multi-layer adaptive attention mechanism and a category embedding feature enhancement module into the Bert model, the accuracy and robustness of the model in the named entity recognition task are effectively improved. The improved model can capture the contextual information of the text more accurately and dynamically adjust the attention distribution, thereby enhancing the modeling ability of complex semantics and long-distance dependencies. In addition, combined with the global optimization of the conditional random field (CRF) layer, the continuity and accuracy of the label sequence are further improved. Experimental results on the CoNLL-2003 dataset show that the improved model outperforms the mainstream comparison model in terms of precision, recall rate, and $F 1$ score, verifying its effectiveness and superiority. This study not only improves the performance of the traditional Bert model in the entity extraction task but also provides new ideas for multimodal expansion, transfer learning, and efficient deployment of entity recognition.

articleTitle: A real-time binocular stereo vision method based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: To meet the environmental perception requirements in fields such as robotics and autonomous driving, this paper proposes an enhanced binocular stereo vision model using a visible light camera and introduces a novel FPGA architecture for its implementation. The classical binocular stereo vision method integrates convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which significantly reduce matching errors. However, this improvement comes at the cost of increased matching time, which, while lowering deployment costs and improving environmental information acquisition, results in practical applications that fall short when compared to methods like LiDAR.To address this issue, we present a real-time stereo matching network that incorporates semantic information. By employing a lightweight design, we substantially reduce the number of parameters while maintaining high accuracy in matching. Additionally, we integrate semantic segmentation branches that allow the network to extract semantic information about the surrounding environment. This not only optimizes stereo matching through semantic features but also enhances environmental awareness technology. Moreover, we design a series of parallel structures to ensure excellent performance on edge computing platforms, such as mobile devices, with the capability for FPGA deployment and acceleration. Finally, we validate our method on the Xilinx FPGA ZYNQ 7010 platform, demonstrating excellent real-time performance and practical results.

articleTitle: Dynamic User Interface Generation for Enhanced Human-Computer Interaction Using Variational Autoencoders
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach for intelligent user interaction interface generation and optimization, grounded in the variational autoencoder (VAE) model. With the rapid advancement of intelligent technologies, traditional interface design methods struggle to meet the evolving demands for diversity and personalization, often lacking flexibility in real-time adjustments to enhance user experience. Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) plays a critical role in addressing these challenges, as it focuses on creating interfaces that are not only functional but also intuitive and responsive to user needs. This research leverages the RICO dataset to train the VAE model, enabling the simulation and creation of user interfaces that align with user aesthetics and interaction habits. Through the integration of real-time user behavior data, the system dynamically refines and optimizes the interface to improve usability, thereby underscoring the importance of HCI in achieving a seamless user experience. The experimental findings indicate that the VAE-based approach significantly enhances the quality and precision of interface generation compared to other methods, including autoencoders (AE), generative adversarial networks (GAN), conditional generative adversarial networks (cGAN), deep belief networks (DBN), and variational autoencoder generative adversarial networks (VAE-GAN). This work contributes valuable insights into Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), providing robust technical solutions for automated interface generation and enhanced user experience optimization.

articleTitle: SwinDSR: Thangka Super-Resolution Model Based on DCT Domain Feature Enhancement and DCT based HQ Image Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Thangka, a form of traditional Tibetan painting, holds deep cultural value and showcases a unique artistic essence. Deep learning-based image super-resolution technology is an effective means to restore low-resolution Thangka images. This technology not only supports the digital preservation of Thangka images but also promotes the global spreading and study of Thangka culture, further enriching the depth of related art and historical research. Nevertheless, current image super-resolution techniques are inadequate for Thangka images due to the following reason: Compared to other publicly available datasets, Thangka images are rich in content, with highly complex textures and colors, making it challenging for current methods to produce high-quality reconstruction, especially in terms of high-frequency details. To overcome these challenges, a Image Super-Resolution Using Swin Transformer And Discrete Cosine Transform (SwinDSR) is proposed, which has a larger receptive field and reconstructs high-definition images in the DCT domain. The method includes two parts: (1) a Discrete Cosine Transform Domain Feature Enhancement Module (DFEM) to expand the receptive field, extract global features, and enhance image quality and structure; (2) a Discrete Cosine Transform based HQ Image Reconstruction (DHR) to avoid the reliance on local pixels during high-resolution image reconstruction, fully utilizing global information while enhancing high-frequency details to improve the consistency of details between the reconstructed Thangka image and the original image. Qualitative and quantitative experiments confirm the proposed method achieves excellent super-resolution effect on Thangka images. The proposed method can contribute to the restoration of low-resolution Thangka images.

articleTitle: Hybrid Encryption/Decryption Embedded System Design Based on ECC, SM3, SM4
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In the context of the current diversification of network attacks, it is evident that the traditional single encryption algorithm is no longer sufficient to meet the requisite security standards. Consequently, there is a pressing need to develop more sophisticated and robust data security measures. Accordingly, this paper proposes an embedded design scheme based on Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC), SM3, SM4 hybrid encryption/decryption system. This utilizes the ECC and SM3 modules to generate SM4 encryption/decryption keys by means of hardware-software co-design, the plaintext/ciphertext is transmitted to the SM4 encryption module via the Advanced High-Performance Bus (AHB) for encryption/decryption of the plaintext/ciphertext. Furthermore, the SM3 module is a joint effort between hardware and software, which minimizes the consumption of hardware resources. The encryption/decryption system is capable of markedly enhancing the security coefficient while simultaneously considering the security of asymmetric encryption and the high speed of symmetric encryption, while also offering the functionality of information verification. The experimental results show that the hardware structure of the hybrid encryption/decryption system designed in this paper is streamlined, the resource utilization is high, the power consumption is relatively low, but the execution rate decreases to a certain extent compared with the pure FPGA hardware, and its resource overhead and time complexity have different degrees of advantages compared with other related references work.

articleTitle: Feasibility and Optimization of DEM Super-Resolution Prediction Using Multi-Factor U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Deep learning methods have been making significant progress in Digital Elevation Model (DEM) super-resolution (SR), with superior performance achieved compared to traditional spatial interpolation methods. By utilizing deep learning techniques to identify the relationship between remote sensing factors and terrain, DEM super-resolution predictions can be made under different conditions, which holds great significance for landslide susceptibility assessments and geological disaster predictions. This study was conducted at the Qingyuan Jiuan landslide test site in Guangdong, where the UNet model was used for DEM super-resolution prediction. The 0.1-meter resolution DEM obtained by LiDAR on February 28, 2023, was used as the output data, and 11 input factors, including multi-source remote sensing data such as Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and differential DEM, were incorporated. A comparison was made between two methods of assigning weights to the 11 influencing factors: equal weighting and empirical preset weighting. The results showed that the preset weighting method was able to predict the DEM more accurately, with the predicted results aligning with the LiDAR-derived DEM data. This research demonstrates the feasibility of using the U-Net model for DEM super-resolution prediction under multi-factor conditions and provides an effective reference for landslide prediction. Additionally, future optimization suggestions, including studies on multi-factor weighting and the integration of low-resolution and high-resolution models, have been proposed to enhance model accuracy and generalization capabilities

articleTitle: Research on the Quantitative Evaluation Model of Information Resource Support Capability for Underwater Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Information resource support capability is a measure of the potential performance of underwater equipment. Objective and accurate quantitative evaluation results are of great significance for making scientific decisions during key activities in the lifecycle of underwater equipment. To address issues such as incomplete coverage of indicators and high uncertainty in indicator weights in the evaluation of information resource support capability, a construction approach for the evaluation indicator system based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is proposed. Additionally, an improved gray relational analysis method is used to determine indicator weights. Taking a specific type of underwater submersible as an example, the feasibility of the method is verified, providing methodological support for the quantitative evaluation of the information resource support capability of underwater equipment.

articleTitle: A Power Grid Service Activity Forecasting Method Based on GRU-PoolTransformer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the ongoing advancements in electric power communication networks, the demand for constructing a more secure, stable, and reliable communication network is increasingly growing among State Grid Corporation of China, major power generation groups, and related tertiary industry enterprises to ensure the steady operation of electric power companies. Monitoring and predicting Power Grid Communication Networks Service Activity (PCNSA) holds significant reference value for identifying electricity usage anomalies, fault localization, preventing network congestion, and optimizing resource allocation. The inherent complex nonlinear relationships and significant short-term fluctuations in electric power time series data pose challenges for traditional single machine learning algorithms in predicting the trends of PCNSA changes. To overcome this challenge, this study conducted an in-depth analysis of electric power network traffic data and proposed an innovative GRU-PoolTransformer algorithm model for short-term PCNSA prediction. The model integrates the Transformer architecture, Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) networks, and attention mechanisms, using bytes, packets, bits, access counts, sessions, and service activities as input features, extracting features through GRU and capturing the periodic characteristics and long-term dependencies of time series data using PoolTransformer networks. Experimental results demonstrate that the GRU-PoolTransformer hybrid deep learning model exhibits higher prediction accuracy in short-term forecasting tasks of PCNSA time series data.

Author Keywords: power grid communication networks service activity

articleTitle: A YOLO-SSES for Complex Background Document Layout Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In natural scenes, document images often encounter complex background challenges caused by lighting interference, diverse document backgrounds, and variations in shooting angles. These challenges manifest as uneven lighting, shadow occlusion, and other phenomena. Additionally, detection targets vary significantly, including extremely large, extremely small, and occluded objects, posing substantial challenges for Document Layout Analysis (DLA). To address these issues, this paper constructs the Natural Scene Document Layout Analysis Dataset (NSD) to compensate for the limitations of existing datasets in complex background scenarios. Furthermore, an improved layout analysis algorithm based on YOLOv8, named YOLO-SSES, is proposed to enhance detection accuracy in complex scenes. To improve the model’s ability to detect extremely large objects, YOLO-SSES incorporates Shift-ConvNets with large convolutional kernels to refine the C2f structure of YOLOv8. Secondly, to address occlusion in document images, a Separated and Enhancement Attention Module (SEAM) is introduced into the detection head. Through its multi-channel fusion mechanism, SEAM effectively enhances the detection of occluded objects. Additionally, to mitigate the adverse effects of lighting variations such as overexposure and shadows, an Edge Search Module (ES) is designed. Finally, to tackle the challenges associated with detecting extremely small objects, a Shallow Feature Fusion (SFF) module is proposed to efficiently fuse shallow features, further improving detection performance. The proposed algorithm was evaluated on the NSD datasets, achieving mAP scores of 74.7%. These results represent significant improvements of 3.46% compared to the baseline YOLOv8. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Capture-U/NDS.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective workshop layout optimization based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In order to improve the workshop production efficiency, this paper establishes a multi-objective mathematical model for optimizing workshop layout with the objectives of minimum logistics handling cost and maximum non-logistics relationship, adopts SLP method to optimize the workshop layout, and substitutes the optimization results into the algorithm as the initial population, and then combines the ant colony algorithm and the genetic algorithm for the solution, and finally arrives at the optimal workshop layout scheme. The material handling cost of the optimized layout is $\mathbf{3 7. 1 \%}$ lower than the original scheme, which verifies the effectiveness of the final scheme. Through this method, the defects of traditional SLP in layout design that is easily influenced by the designer’s experience can be effectively avoided, and the difficulty that the ant colony algorithm is prone to fall into local optimization can be solved at the same time.

articleTitle: PSO-based Prediction Method for CNN-LSTM-Attention Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In the information age, the open nature of the Internet has made network security issues increasingly severe. Within the domain of network security, predicting the security situation is a fundamental aspect, which aims to identify potential security threats. To effectively quantify the current state of network security, we develop a situational assessment system that evaluates the impact of network attacks. Meanwhile, in order to improve the accuracy of situation prediction, a CNN-LSTM-Attention network prediction method based on particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the average absolute error of our proposed model is 0.0321 and its determination coefficient is 0.9660, indicating a notable improvement in prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Cooperative Navigation Filtering Algorithm Based on Improved Maximum Correntropy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the thick-tailed non-Gaussian noise generated by the complex environment and complex flight dynamics leads to the poor navigation effect of the master-slave Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) conavigation, an Improved Maximum Correlation Entropy Kalman Filter (IMCKF) algorithm is proposed. To address the algorithm’s sensitivity to correlation entropy error and to outliers, the stability of the filtering is ensured by introducing residual weight coefficients and estimating the cholesky decomposition matrix of the noise by using expectations with robustness to weight the residuals; and it is used to optimize the kernel-width updating, which solves the problems of the algorithm relying on the kernelwidth’s local convergence criterion and the uneven convergence speed. Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of UAV formation cooperative navigation.

articleTitle: CT-ARF: Detecting Ethereum Fraudulent Accounts with High Recall Rate and Low False Negative Rate Using ARFBoost and CTDA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The development of blockchain technology has promoted the growth of cryptocurrencies, but it has also provided criminals with opportunities to engage in fraudulent activities. Currently, Ethereum fraud detection models based on machine learning face challenges such as feature redundancy and class imbalance, which lead to a high false negative rate. To address these issues, this paper proposes an improved CT-ARF detector to enhance the detection of fraudulent activities on Ethereum. This approach combines the ARFBoost feature enhancement mechanism and the CTDA (Conditioned Table Generative Adversarial Network-based) data augmentation strategy. First, we apply Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) to select the most relevant and representative features from Ethereum transaction data, removing redundant or irrelevant features to improve data quality and obtain an optimal feature subset. Next, we design a multi-dimensional synchronized embedding technique that integrates performance evaluation metrics for each feature into the embedding model, thereby enhancing the contribution of each feature to target identification. Additionally, we use CTDA for data augmentation to address the class imbalance issue, further improving the model’s robustness and accuracy. Finally, we evaluate a CT-ARF detector with the Ethereum fraud detection dataset using LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, AdaBoost, RF, DT, and KNN. The results demonstrate that a CT-ARF detector effectively improves the recall rate of Ethereum fraud detection while reducing the false negative rate.

articleTitle: A Deep Phishing Email Detection Model Combing Multi-Features Based on Word Frequency and Contextual Semantics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Due to the ability to automatically extract phishing features without relying on expert knowledge, deep learning methods have been widely applied in the research of phishing email classification and detection.
